title: AXI Write Association and Response Model
description: Execute independent AW/W acceptance, pre-AW buffering, revision-aware W association, exact beat/LAST state, per-ID response queues, and configured underflow/overflow checks.
learnerQuestion: How does a checker associate accepted W data with AW requests before allowing exactly one B response?

configurations.label: AXI4 · depth 2
configurations.description: No WID; W bursts follow AW order; two accepted write requests maximum.

configurations.label: AXI3 · WID aware
configurations.description: WID selects the write-data transaction under AXI3 interleaving rules.

scenarios.label: AXI4 AW-first with W stall
scenarios.description: AW allocates the request first; W can start later and must retain its complete payload while WREADY is LOW.

checks.label: AW allocates one write
checks.evidence: An accepted AW entry waits for its AXI4 AW-order W burst.

checks.label: Stall does not consume a beat
checks.evidence: The source retains the complete W payload until acceptance.

checks.label: Complete W payload retained
checks.evidence: Data, byte strobes, LAST, and USER when present remain stable.

steps.label: Accept W and B
steps.event: Two W handshakes, WLAST on beat 2, then B handshake

checks.label: One burst gets one B response
checks.evidence: Accepted AW and final W enable one stable response, retired on B handshake.

scenarios.label: AXI4 simultaneous AW/W
scenarios.description: AW and the first W beat can transfer on the same edge; independent channel handshakes still create separate accepted events.

steps.label: Accept AW + W
steps.event: AWVALID&&AWREADY and WVALID&&WREADY on one edge

checks.label: AW accepted independently
checks.evidence: Simultaneity does not merge the AW and W channel rules.

checks.label: Both response prerequisites met
checks.evidence: A single-beat burst accepted its AW and final W on the same edge; BVALID cannot depend on BREADY.

scenarios.label: Independent AW/W/B stalls
scenarios.description: READY delays vary independently while each source retains VALID and its payload; a stable B response waits for acceptance without being withdrawn.

steps.label: Delay AWREADY
steps.event: AWVALID held for three cycles before AWREADY

checks.label: AW payload persists
checks.evidence: The AW source does not wait for or withdraw VALID because READY is LOW.

steps.label: Delay WREADY
steps.event: WVALID payload held for two cycles

checks.label: W payload persists
checks.evidence: Independent W backpressure does not alter accepted AW state.

checks.label: B response persists
checks.evidence: The subordinate source retains BVALID, BID, BRESP, and BUSER until handshake.

scenarios.label: AXI4 W-first association
scenarios.description: This destination accepts one W beat before AW, then joins it to the head of the accepted-AW order and waits for both response prerequisites.

steps.label: Accept early W
steps.event: WVALID && WREADY accepts D0 before AW

checks.label: Accepted early W is retained
checks.evidence: Because WREADY accepted the beat, it cannot be discarded while waiting for AW association.

checks.label: B not yet eligible
checks.evidence: AXI4 still lacks accepted AW and accepted final W.

checks.label: Configured AW depth
checks.evidence: The accepted-AW queue allocates one entry without exceeding the configured limit.

checks.label: AXI4 association mode
checks.evidence: AXI4 has no WID; W belongs to requests in write-address order.

checks.label: WLAST exact accepted beat
checks.evidence: Backpressured cycles do not increment the beat counter.

checks.label: Both AXI4 prerequisites met
checks.evidence: Accepted AW plus accepted final W permits BVALID independently of BREADY.

checks.label: One response retires one write
checks.evidence: The per-ID head is removed only on an accepted B transfer.

checks.label: No response underflow
checks.evidence: BID mapped to an eligible outstanding write.

scenarios.label: AXI3 WID association
scenarios.description: WID selects the corresponding accepted write stream instead of applying the AXI4 no-WID rule.

steps.label: Interleave WID
steps.event: WID 0 beat, WID 1 beat, WID 0 WLAST

checks.label: Revision selects WID
checks.evidence: The checker is explicitly configured for AXI3 rather than applying AXI4 AW-order association.

checks.label: ID0 complete
checks.evidence: WID-aware counters retain independent accepted-beat state.

scenarios.label: Unexpected B response
scenarios.description: A BID with no eligible accepted-AW/final-W entry is a response underflow.

steps.label: Accept unmatched B
steps.event: BID=7 handshake with empty per-ID queue

checks.label: Response must match eligible write
checks.evidence: The checker flags the first accepted B response without a corresponding transaction.

traceability.requirement: AXI-W accepted AW + final W before BVALID
traceability.checker: AW queue + pre-AW W join + B eligibility
traceability.coverage: channel order × W stalls × B stalls × depth

traceability.stimulus: AXI3 WID interleave and AXI4 AW order
